note: Village of Avoca campground near Avoca Lake, a backwater off the Wisconsin River, with swimming and fishing in the lake, a free boat launch, play areas and a ballfield. Seasonal sites are also sold; the village doesn't say how many. --Claude
summary: Village page read: $30 electric / $35 electric+water, seasonal $700/$800, phone reservations or pay at the box (fcfs always). Season, count, 50 A and dump rested only on disagreeing directories - cleared. Not waterfront confirmed (lake ~250-300 m north behind houses). Seasonal share unpublished. Phone confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The campground is the wooded loop SE of the pin (~43.1884,-90.3195); Avoca Lake is ~250-300 m north behind houses and the ballfield (Esri).

SEASONAL SHARE: unknown. The village sells seasonals ($700/$800) but states no counts; Good Sam's directory says 33 seasonal sites against 75-105 total in other directories (not the operator's figure).
